name: Traumend ~Etude~
source: A car accident in her youth cost the protagonist's mother her life and left the girl unable to walk. She finds peace in playing the piano - her only link to her deceased mother - and shuts herself off from the rest of the world.
translation: 年轻时的一场车祸夺走了主角母亲的生命，也让女孩无法行走。她在弹钢琴中找到了平静——她与已故母亲的唯一联系——并将自己与世隔绝。
